result.summary: Found 2 minor layout issues related to text truncation and clipping on restaurant names.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccolo' is truncated to 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section.
issues.suggestion: Adjust font size, container width, or use text-overflow ellipsis to handle longer names gracefully.

issues.description: The name 'Tokumaru Ramen' is clipped at the end, displaying as 'Tokumaru Rameı' due to insufficient horizontal space.
issues.suggestion: Increase the width of the text container or implement auto-scaling font size for longer titles.
